source_caption_text:
PART 3 OF 3 🧵 | THE VERDICT
The defense fought to the end. A key witness said "I made it up." Beezy's phone pinged 40 miles from the barbershop. The gun and the black Camaro were never found.
Then the prosecutor told the jury to focus on three things: "motive, money, and the man."
The jury asked to see three things again: the rap lyrics, the FBI reports, and the financial statements.
After 4+ hours, the verdict came in at 2:40 PM on November 11th, the six-year anniversary of the day MO3 was killed. It was unanimous.
People stormed out. Family members cried. Then at 3 PM, the DA was seen hugging MO3's mother.
"I believe that this happened for a reason this way."
It's not over. An appeal is already being planned, and one more man is still waiting on his trial.
🎥 Full story on Ceddy Nash Uncut. Link in my story.
